question_intents: How to operate and configure Qursor AGV interfaces and traffic zones
data.summary: This collection of user guides covers the operation and configuration of Qursor's various human-machine interfaces, including the AGV HMI, MAP dashboard, and Tablet Application. It details workflows for managing AGV modes, executing tasks, configuring Kanbans, and setting up traffic zones for vehicle control.

children.title: Traffic-zones-configuration-1.2
children.summary: This user manual documents the configuration of the Qursor platform's Hector connector, detailing the definition and management of 2D polygon zones for AGV traffic control. It explains the operational logic of traffic light zones for signal activation and lock zones for separating AGV and unmanaged vehicle areas, including procedures for manual overrides. The guide further covers the administrative setup of these zones using the configurator and their integration with Navithor maps via JSON mapping.
question_intents: How are traffic light and lock zones configured and managed in the Qursor platform?
